ctx.x: Yeah. I didn't tell you that? Oh, yeah. You were playing trumpet? Yeah. Playing the same time music. Drew Otto was playing. Let's see. Who can tell you that? Eddie Garland can tell you. Mine ought to remember that, too. No, I don't know mine. I think it helps. Who'd you have in that band?
Thank God. You were here. You were dressed again. You had two jobs. You played with Elgar and then...

items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: He had Donnell Howard on it.

ctx.x: He had Donnell Howard on it. Yeah. Clionette, Barney Biggar, Nick. Nick, you know Nick. Clionette, Albert. Had them three guys on Clionette. And Tennant, they all played Tennant. Well, you know, that's what they called. He paid about a thousand dollars there. And they couldn't hit a tap. And they called him where it was loaded. And the man walked up there and said, I'm sorry. He'd have paid us right now.
You stayed out here and there.
